good_when: Code that builds a line with a whole-number price, such as `Line("Hosting", 50, 1)`, got an invoice and totals from render, subtotal and total in 1.4.0. In 1.5.0 it stops with `AttributeError: 'int' object has no attribute 'quantize'`.
`--rate 19 --rate 7` quietly prints the invoice at 7%, so a wrong invoice can go out with no word.
